data.description:
## Context / Problem

Discovered from obtuse-phenocryst-verdin. `src/rebar/_store/gitutil.py:199` and `:229` run git with `text=True` and no `encoding`, and `src/rebar/attest/sshsig.py:51` runs `ssh -V` the same way. On Windows the output is decoded as cp1252, so non-ASCII git output (commit subjects, paths, ticket titles) is garbled or raises `UnicodeDecodeError` on bytes cp1252 leaves undefined (0x81/0x8D/0x8F/0x90/0x9D). Found as `EncodingWarning` under `PYTHONWARNDEFAULTENCODING=1` while running the text-encoding Windows-sweep tests; no current sweep failure is attributed to them.

## Approach

Pass `encoding="utf-8"` (git emits UTF-8 by default; `errors="replace"` where output is diagnostic only) at each site, with a Linux-gate test that runs the call under `-X warn_default_encoding -W error::EncodingWarning`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Each listed call names its encoding, and a regression test fails on the pre-fix code.
- [ ] `make verify` passes.
data.title: git and ssh subprocess output decoded with the locale codec (gitutil, sshsig)
